title: Tasks in flight, and every worker
description: What GET /api/v1/tasks answers and `ingestion tasks list --json` prints: the tasks in the states asked for, the most recently changed first, and each worker with its last heartbeat. A task's error can quote outsider text, so the answer carries only whether one is kept.

item_key.description: The item a stage's task works on, and null for a poll.

connector.description: The connector a poll fetches for, or the connector whose sighting a delete removes from its source, and null for every other stage's task.

destination.description: The destination a deliver task writes its item to, and null for every other task.

model.description: The model that a measurement arm's task asks its run for, and null for every other task.

capability.description: What a worker needs to claim the task: poll:<source> for a poll, parse:<extractor> for a parse, deliver:<deliverer> for a delivery and delete:<source> for a delete.

held_by.description: The connector whose first fill holds this queued task until a person releases it.

lapsed.description: The task is leased and its lease ran out, so the next claim takes it.

lease_holder.description: The worker that claimed the task last.

attempts.description: The claims that leased the task, but each that ended waiting on its far end or on a stopping worker.

has_error.description: The task keeps the error of its last failure.

not_before_ts.description: A retried task's backoff ends here.

waiting_since_ts.description: When a report first said the task waits on its far end or on a stopping worker, and null where none has.

workers.description: Each worker heard from recently enough to list by default, or every worker the service holds where the request asked for workers=all. Each process start is a worker of its own.

workers_hidden.description: How many workers the default list leaves out, because none was heard from recently enough.
